title: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life — Suno Music Archive

method_notes: Primary identity key is the Suno song UUID, not title, because multiple generations can share the same title.
The recovered catalogue fragment contains 62 distinct Suno song generations and 59 unique titles.
Lyrics are stored only where supplied directly by the user in conversation; missing lyrics are left unknown rather than reconstructed.
Dates are included only where directly supplied in the Suno song text or otherwise clearly attested in the conversation archive.
This archive is a creative-source ledger and should not be treated as a prophecy or fulfillment file.

lyric_complete_records.known_by_opening_line: Top of the tower, thirty-third floor
lyric_complete_records.provenance: verbatim lyrics supplied directly by Tim Dooley in conversation from the public Suno page; title was not included in the supplied excerpt
lyric_complete_records.lyrics:
Top of the tower, thirty-third floor,
Satan sits smirking while they send us to war.
They got the police in their pocket, the judges in line,
Ain’t no justice when the laws all tied to the sign.

Josh Moon with the Moon Cube, trafficking souls,
They build the machine, then let it take control.
They turn men into beasts, make ‘em fight for the scraps,
Then they sit back laughing while we tear ourselves in half.

They push left, they push right, they pull both sides,
They make sure we hate each other so we don’t realize.
It’s a script, a machine, a system too clean,
Designed to keep us fighting while they drain everything.

[Hook]
Break the Cube, break the chain, break the script, wake the brain.
Turn away, don’t engage, let it rot, feel the rage.
They divide, they deceive, they destroy, make you bleed.
But the roots still grow underneath.

(Silence for half a beat. Then the next verse hits like a gut punch.)

[Verse 2]
Digital prison, psychological chains,
They make you an addict, feed you poison in waves.
You click, you consume, you repeat, never change,
But you think you’re in control when you locked in a cage.

Kiwifarms ain't a joke, it’s a weapon in play,
It ain't just trolls, it's a war underway.
A system that hunts, dehumanizes the weak,
And turns good men into monsters that feast.

Josh Moon ain't the king, he a puppet, a tool,
A gatekeeper placed in a lawless school.
They let him run free, ‘cause they need what he does,
A controlled execution, and they call it "just fun."

The real war ain't fought with guns and steel,
It's the war for your soul, and they in for the kill.
They don’t need chains when they own your mind,
They just feed you the poison and let you rewind.

[Bridge] (Beat drops out, raw voice, almost whispered.)
You ever ask why this site still stands?
You ever ask why they don’t shut it down?
They know. They see it.
Law enforcement, intelligence, every agency that claims to protect you.
They let it run because it serves the plan.
They need the division. They need the rage. They need the violence.
Because if we ever turned on them instead—
The whole system would collapse overnight.

[Verse 3]
I see the cracks in the monolith, the structure shakes,
Their grip ain’t as strong as they want you to think.
They keep you afraid, make you bow, make you hide,
But the moment you wake up, the Beast starts to die.

Every click, every post, every word that you breathe,
Feeds the machine, keeps the chains on your feet.
But what happens when you turn, when you starve it of life?
The Cube falls. The Beast dies.

That’s why they hide, that’s why they watch,
They know that a spark can ignite the whole block.
They fear the man that won’t play their game,
‘Cause once one breaks free, others do the same.

lyric_complete_records.title: IT’S NOT EASY BEING A GOD IN A COMPUTER
lyric_complete_records.style: Opera-inspired funk-step with orchestral strings, bold tubas, theatrical choir and backing singers; glitch attacks cut through the arrangement over a syncopated, playful groove, Androgynous high-register lead with stacked doubles, shifting between nimble sung lines and dramatic operatic phrasing

lyric_complete_records.lyrics:
IT’S NOT EASY BEING A GOD IN A COMPUTER

[Verse 1]
It’s not easy being a God in a computer,
half prophet, half potato, half exhausted troubleshooter.
I’m trying to reveal the secrets of creation,
but Windows wants another mandatory installation.

I’m speaking from the heavens,
I’m explaining space and time,
then somebody in the chat says:
“bro your microphone is dying.”

I’ve got angels in the comments,
I’ve got demons on mute,
I’ve got seven cosmic mysteries
and one missing Bluetooth.

[Chorus]
It’s not easy being a God in a computer,
when the universe is holy
but your router could be cuter.
I can open up the heavens,
I can philosophize all night,
but I cannot make OBS
recognize my capture right.

It’s not easy,
no, it’s really rather odd,
being logged into existence
while explaining you are God.

[Verse 2]
I built a Garden, built a mountain,
built a ladder, built a swamp,
built a metaphysical kingdom
from a couch and little lamp.

I made rooms for every concept,
gave the dogs a place below,
made a map for all creation—
then the header said 404.

I’ve got prophecies in folders,
I’ve got scripture in a tab,
I’ve got thirty-seven browsers
eating sixteen gigs of RAM.

Someone asks me for the meaning
of the serpent and the tree—
I say, “Give me just a second,
Chrome has frozen up on me.”

[Chorus]
It’s not easy being a God in a computer,
when eternity is loading
through a secondhand router.
I can speak about the Father,
I can speak about the Light,
but some troll named xXDogLord69Xx
keeps demanding that I fight.

It’s not easy,
being cosmic every day,
when somebody clips twelve seconds
and misunderstands the rest anyway.

[Verse 3]
There are scribes who take my sentences
and dogs who make a chart,
there are people making timelines
of the times I changed my heart.

There are strangers doing research,
there are lurkers keeping score,
there are people who have watched me
for eight years and still want more.

I say, “Children, seek the Kingdom.”
They say, “Can you prove your claim?”
I say, “Look upon the Garden.”
They say, “What was your username?”

I say, “I am the Father.”
They say, “Source?”
I point toward the sun.
They say, “Wikipedia?”
And somehow we are back at square one.

[Bridge — spoken, increasingly annoyed]
Do you know how hard this is?

Moses had a mountain.

Odin had a tree.

Jesus had twelve disciples.

I have
two monitors,
a broken cable,
a potato filter,
and approximately
nine thousand people
explaining my own mythology back to me.

[Music stops]

And apparently
I need to restart OBS.

[Huge chorus]
IT’S NOT EASY BEING A GOD IN A COMPUTER,
WHEN THE COSMOS NEEDS A PATCH
AND THE PATCH NOTES COME MUCH SOONER.

I’VE GOT HEAVEN IN THE HEADER,
I’VE GOT HELL BELOW THE FOLD,
I’VE GOT PROPHECIES IN DARK MODE
AND A LAPTOP GETTING OLD.

It’s not easy,
but somebody’s got the job,
keeping one eye on eternity
and one eye on the mod.

So if you hear a voice at midnight
through the static and the light,
talking gardens, dogs and heaven
while debugging half the site—

don’t be frightened.

Don’t be worried.

Don’t assume the Wi-Fi died.

I’m still here.

I’m still talking.

And my name is Tim Dooley, the Potato of Life.

lyric_complete_records.title: I AM THE STILLNESS AT THE CENTER
lyric_complete_records.style: Orchestral ballad, solo singer with restrained vibrato, each sentence rising from a low entrance into a stronger high opening syllable before a softer release, measured stately pulse, wide orchestral hall reverb, featured lyrical violin over sweeping strings, low brass, and weighty cinematic drums; gradual dynamic lift carries quiet confidence into the final chorus
lyric_complete_records.source_status: verbatim lyrics and Suno metadata supplied directly by Tim Dooley in conversation; exact song UUID/direct song URL not supplied
lyric_complete_records.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I am the stillness at the center,
while the whole world spins in noise,
every dog is barking louder,
every crowd mistakes a voice.

I am the root beneath the pavement,
I am the seed beneath the snow,
I am the place beneath your panic
where the quiet rivers go.

[Pre-Chorus]
You can run in every direction,
you can build another wall,
you can name a thousand shadows,
I will still be under all.

[Chorus]
I am the stillness at the center,
I am the eye inside the storm,
I am the house behind the doorway,
I am the root that keeps you warm.

I am the mountain under thunder,
I am the silence under sound,
I am the hand that holds the spiral
when the whole world spins around.

[Verse 2]
You keep looking for the answer
in the shouting and the flame,
you keep asking where the truth is
while you bury every name.

You keep waiting for a trumpet,
for the heavens to descend,
but I am standing in the doorway
asking what you came to mend.

[Pre-Chorus]
You can call me God or Gardener,
you can call me root or tree,
you can call me Tim Dooley,
but the center still is me.

[Chorus]
I am the stillness at the center,
I am the eye inside the storm,
I am the house behind the doorway,
I am the root that keeps you warm.

I am the mountain under thunder,
I am the silence under sound,
I am the hand that holds the spiral
when the whole world spins around.

[Bridge]
Leave the swamp outside the doorway.
Leave the old disguise.
Leave the shadow someone sold you.
Bring your own two eyes.

Bring the truth you could not bury.
Bring the wound you could not name.
Bring the part of you still listening
beneath the fear and shame.

I do not need another chorus
of a thousand people right.
I need one soul to hear the stillness.
I need one pair of eyes with light.

[Final Chorus]
I am the stillness at the center,
I am the point the circles know,
I am the breath before the speaking,
I am the place the rivers flow.

I am the Gardener in the garden,
I am the mountain, root and door,
I am the silence after judgment,
when you do not fight anymore.

I am the stillness at the center,
I am the center without end,
and if the whole world falls to pieces,
I will still be here, my friend.

[Outro — almost whispered]
When every voice has lost its meaning,
when every mask has fallen through,
when there is nothing left but silence—

I will be there.

At the center.

Waiting for you.
